mentions.name: Space Trader
mentions.description: A multiplayer space trading and strategy game that mixes Magic: The Gathering, StarCraft, and Civilization's hex grid combat. It supports multiplayer, though the game server has not been hosted publicly yet, and the developer is seeking name suggestions since other games share the name.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Space Trader!

Imagine mixing Magic: The Gathering, StarCraft and Civilization’s hex grid combat.

There’s multiplayer but I haven’t put the server anywhere yet.
